sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 5 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 5 OF 1985
NATIONAL AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (BASIS OF ELECTIONS) (REPEAL) ORDER,
1985
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 16th January, 1985].
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information : -
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President and Chief Martial Law Administrator is pleased to
make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be called the National and Provincial Assemblies
(Basis of Elections) (Repeal) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Repeal of P. O. No. 14 of 1979.--The National and
Provincial Assemblies (Basis of Elections) Order. 1979 (P. O. No. 14 of 1979),
is hereby repealed.
